snippet.description:
Vox’s Astead Herndon talked to voters in Nevada about how the current administration is influencing their feelings in the upcoming midterms. From the economy to local workplace impacts, voters are reflecting on the real-world effects of Trump’s presidency — and realizing what was in the fine print all along. 

Listen to the latest episode of America, Actually to hear what’s driving people to the polls wherever you get your podcasts.
